label: GO
recommendation: Raise to $3,500 for new clients starting now, and keep current clients at $2,000 only until a written trigger moves them up. The room is unanimous on B (8.0 weighted). Capacity is the one fact that could favor a staged raise for everyone, so confirm it first.
conditions: Close rate at $3,500 stays above 29% across the first 15 logged sales calls. This is the break-even line Graham, Gary V, and Wickman all named. Above 35%, move current clients sooner (Gary V).
Current clients step up after 15 calls at $3,500 or 30 days, whichever is later (Graham's trigger). They get 60 days' personal notice, effective at their next billing cycle (Martell, Bezos, Gary V).
At least 12 of 15 current clients can name a concrete result and say they would stay at the step-up, checked by asking each one (Graham).
Six months of operating cash on hand before any current client is moved, so a 30 to 50% drop in clients does not threaten runway (Wickman).
Founder confirms in writing that no client contract blocks a price change, and states max client capacity and weekly hours (Graham, Wickman, Martell).
next_steps: Day 1: Write down max client capacity, current weekly coaching hours, and whether a waitlist exists. If the roster is full with a waitlist, flag it for review, since Martell, Bezos, and Gary V say a staged raise for everyone gets much stronger then.
Day 1: Review all 15 client agreements for terms that block a price change.
Day 1: Update the sales page and call script to $3,500 for every new prospect.
Day 2: Start a scorecard tracking calls, closes at $3,500, active clients, founder hours, and cash on hand, updated weekly (Wickman).
Days 1 to 14: Hold short check-in calls with each current client. Ask what result they got and what the coaching is worth to them. Do not announce the raise yet.
Day 30 or after call 15, whichever is later: Compare the close rate to 29%. If it clears, call each current client personally, starting with the strongest results, and give 60 days' notice.
Day 90: Every client on one price. No two-tier roster past this date.
cheapest_test: Quote $3,500 on the next 15 sales calls with no other change to the offer, log each outcome, and compare the close rate to the 29% break-even line.
kill_criteria: If the close rate at $3,500 is below 29% after 15 calls, return new-client pricing to $2,000, keep current clients where they are, and treat the raise as unproven until client results are documented. If 4 or more current clients say they would quit at the step-up, do not move current clients. Re-run the check in 90 days.
